## Requirements

(From the contract — deliverables 1–9.)

1. D-A in `ci.yml`: triggers push→main-only + pull_request + workflow_dispatch;
   `permissions: contents: read, actions: read`; event-scoped concurrency.
2. `scripts/ci/fast-path.sh` (nondocs-tree / decide / record) +
   `scripts/ci/test-fast-path.sh` (throwaway git repos + CI_ANCHOR_LISTING
   fixtures; every fast/full/failure case).
3. The D-B5 wiring + D-C spike gating in `ci.yml`, incl. header block.
4. `scripts/ci/check-ci-gating.sh` (step-mode lint + readers scan) +
   `scripts/ci/test-check-ci-gating.sh` + `scripts/ci/docs-readers.allow`.
5. `scripts/ci/full-run.sh` (read <sha>) + `scripts/ci/test-full-run.sh`
   (gh shim + fixture JSON).
6. ADR-0362 (next free) — D-A..D-D, safety/threat, rejected alternatives,
   revisit triggers, before/after; regenerate `docs/adr/README.md`.
7. `AGENTS.md`: ci.yml Key-files row, Build & Test full-run line, step-mode
   gotcha.
8. Dated `> Amended <date> (R4.2a, ADR-<n>):` notes on 164p, 164q, 164r, 165,
   164a, 166, 167b.
9. Hosted proofs (AC 6–8): open DF-R4.2a-1 in DEFERRALS.md; measure this PR's
   heads; AC 7 dispatch or refused-branch.

Budgets: production ≤400 changed lines (ci.yml + scripts/ci/*.sh minus
test-*); tests ≤450 (test-*.sh + fixtures). Stop lines 600/675. The only
permitted cut is deliverable 5 → L4.3; the lint is never cut.
